units.source_text: 上面那帮家伙竟松开了手！

en.t: The people up above had actually let go!

units.source_text: ……转了半圈，头朝下地摔在了沙地上。

en.t: ...He spun halfway around and fell headfirst onto the sand.

units.source_text: 身体之下，采集箱发出了嘎的一声。

en.t: Beneath his body, the collecting box gave a sharp crack.

units.source_text: 接着，什么东西掠过脸颊飞走了。

en.t: Then something skimmed past his cheek and flew away.
It seemed to be the hook on the rope.

units.source_text: 真是群什么都干得出来的家伙呀。

en.t: They really were the kind of people who would do anything.
Fortunately, he had not been hurt in the fall.

units.source_text: 除了撞上采集箱的侧腹部，也没有作痛的地方。

en.t: Aside from his side, which had struck the collecting box, nothing else hurt.

units.source_text: 他反射般地跳了起来，摸索刚才那根绳索。

en.t: He sprang up reflexively and groped for the rope from just before.

units.source_text: 老早就给上面那些家伙提去了。

en.t: It had already been hauled up by the people above.
